candidates.problem: Preserving personal contextual memories and stories linked to songs and performances beyond just the media content
candidates.selfBuiltSolution: Created a dedicated subsite using wesing.ai that combines performance videos with user‑submitted 60‑second audio clips and short text annotations, allowing logged‑in users to record and attach personal reflections to each piece
candidates.reasoning: The author identified a personal need to capture nuanced memories and built a concrete AI‑enhanced workflow to do so, demonstrating a genuine lead‑user signal.

candidates.title: Show HN: WhisperWriter – Speech-to-text using OpenAI's Whisper, coded by ChatGPT
candidates.snippet: WhisperWriter is a small dictation app that uses OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition model to auto-transcribe recordings from a user's microphone. I built it with the help of ChatGPT (with GPT-4) and GitHub Copilot, with almost every line of code in the repository written by AI. Running the app: Everything you need to know to set WhisperWriter up is in the linked GitHub repo's README file. The app can be run locally using the open-source Whisper release or online through the OpenAI API. I personally use the latter because my computer is not very powerful, but the former is free
